Limitations of agentic AI (synthetic)

A common limitation of agentic systems is compounding error, where an early wrong step is carried through later steps without being noticed.

Another limitation is cost and latency, because looping agents can issue many model calls for a single request.

Evaluation remains difficult because outputs are open-ended and tool results change over time.
